_purpose: PREREGISTRATION T76, its coupling rule, round 4: round 3 (2,000 fair sweeps) found the flat 16 x 16 sheet melting from g = 3.5 upward, so the small targets lie on the melting edge; this round reads the colder side, g = 2.8 to 3.4, at the same length and 16 replicas, to find whether a small density holds steady there. Calibration of the protocol, not a growth run; every coupling tried is kept.
name: t76_settle_r4
